steps.instruction: Lie on your back or sit comfortably. Place one hand on your chest and one on your abdomen.
Inhale slowly through your nose for 4 counts. Feel your abdomen rise — your chest should stay still.
Hold for 2 counts.
Exhale slowly through pursed lips for 6 counts. Feel your abdomen fall.
Repeat for 10 minutes.

modifications.modified_instruction: Reduce hold to 1 count. Focus on exhale length.

name: Anulom Vilom (Alternate Nostril Breathing)

steps.instruction: Sit cross-legged or in a chair with spine straight.
Close right nostril with right thumb. Inhale through left nostril for 4 counts.
Close left nostril with ring finger. Release right nostril. Exhale for 8 counts.
Inhale through right nostril for 4 counts. Switch and exhale through left for 8 counts.
This is one cycle. Repeat for 10 minutes.

evidence_source: Yoga Research Foundation; Pranayama for Hypertension Meta-analysis 2022

steps.instruction: Begin at a slow comfortable pace for first 3 minutes (warm-up).
Maintain a pace where you can hold a conversation — slightly breathless is fine.
Slow down for last 3 minutes (cool-down).

modifications.modified_instruction: Walk on flat surfaces only. Avoid inclines.

name: Post-Meal Walk

steps.instruction: Begin 10-15 minutes after finishing your meal.
Walk at a leisurely strolling pace — significantly slower than your normal walk.
Avoid anything more strenuous for 45 minutes after eating.

evidence_source: Diabetes Care Journal 2022 — Post-meal walking and glycaemic control

steps.instruction: Sit at edge of chair. Roll shoulders backward 10 times, then forward 10 times.
Neck tilt: slowly tilt head to right shoulder, hold 20 seconds. Switch sides.
Seated spinal twist: hands on armrests, twist torso right and hold 20 seconds. Switch.
Seated forward bend: feet flat, hinge forward slowly from hips, hands toward floor. Hold 30 seconds.
Ankle rolls: lift both feet, rotate ankles clockwise 10 times, then counter-clockwise.

modifications.modified_instruction: Skip forward bend. Consult physio first.

steps.instruction: Stand arm's length from wall. Place palms flat on wall at shoulder height.
Bend elbows slowly to bring chest toward wall. Keep body straight.
Push back to start. Do 3 sets of 10 repetitions with 60-second rest between sets.

modifications.modified_instruction: Avoid holding breath. Exhale on push phase.

steps.instruction: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Lower slowly as if sitting into a chair — keep chest up, knees over toes.
Go to 90 degrees or as low as comfortable. Return to standing.
3 sets of 12 repetitions. Rest 90 seconds between sets.

modifications.modified_instruction: Half squat only — go to 45 degrees. Use chair for support.

name: Surya Namaskar (Modified — 6 rounds)

steps.instruction: Mountain pose: stand tall, palms together at chest. Take 3 deep breaths.
Arms up: inhale, raise arms overhead. Slight backbend.
Forward fold: exhale, hinge at hips, reach toward floor. Bend knees generously.
Lunge: inhale, step right leg back. Left knee over ankle.
Plank: hold 5-10 seconds (skip if shoulder/wrist issue).
Child's pose instead of upward dog for beginners. Hold 20 seconds.
Downward dog: hips high, heels toward floor. 5 breaths.
Reverse the sequence. Complete 6 rounds at a comfortable pace.

modifications.modified_instruction: Skip plank and downward dog — do standing sequences only.

evidence_source: Indian Journal of Physiology and Pharmacology

steps.instruction: Anchor band to door handle or post at waist height.
Hold both ends, step back until band has tension. Hinge slightly at hips.
Pull elbows back squeezing shoulder blades together. Hold 1 second at peak.
3 sets of 12. Rest 60 seconds between sets.

name: Balance Standing (Single Leg)

steps.instruction: Stand near wall for support. Lift one foot slightly off ground.
Hold balance for 10-30 seconds. Use wall only if needed.
Switch feet. Repeat 5 times per side.

modifications.modified_instruction: Always have chair nearby. Lift foot only 5cm.

evidence_source: British Geriatrics Society Fall Prevention Guidelines

steps.instruction: Sit comfortably with eyes closed. Plug both ears with thumbs.
Inhale deeply through nose.
Exhale slowly while making a steady humming sound like a bee.
Repeat 10-12 times.
Sit in chair with back straight, feet flat on floor.
Straighten one leg parallel to floor. Hold 5 seconds.
Lower slowly. Alternate legs. 3 sets of 15 per leg.
Stand with feet hip-width apart. Light fingertip touch on wall.
Rise up on toes slowly over 2 counts.
Hold 1 second at top.
Lower slowly over 3 counts. 3 sets of 15.

modifications.modified_instruction: Use both hands on wall. Reduce range of motion.

steps.instruction: Start in child's pose: kneel, hips to heels, arms extended forward. Hold 2 minutes.
Cat-Cow: on hands and knees. Inhale — back sways down (cow). Exhale — back rounds up (cat). 10 cycles.
Thread the needle: from all-fours, slide right arm under left, rest right shoulder on mat. Hold 45 sec each side.
Return to child's pose. Rest 2 minutes.
Warm up with 5 minutes of slow walk.
Increase pace to brisk — 5-6 km/h target. Swing arms actively.
Maintain pace where you can barely sing but can speak in short sentences.
Cool down 5 minutes slow walk.

modifications.modified_instruction: Keep HR below 65% max (220 - age). Use rate of perceived exertion: 5/10.
